name: @projexlight/sdk-catalog-index
summary: Global SDK catalog RAG store (P9.2 / Epic A). Auto-migrates the catalog.* schema (Postgres + pgvector, global-catalog pool), then incrementally syncs every sdk-capability.json into catalog.sdk / catalog.endpoint / catalog.embedding — embedding natural-language cards with the local bge-small model. Backs the Build-with-AI planner's retrieve-then-compose pipeline and the registry MCP's semantic search, get_endpoint, and get_ingest_targets surfaces. Source of truth for SDK discovery; the file-based registry index is the offline/CLI mirror.

events.name: catalog.synced.v1
events.description: An incremental catalog sync completed; carries the new catalog version and the count of changed SDKs. Registry MCP hot-indexes reload on this.

models.description: One row per published SDK: summary, tags, tier (foundation|domain), pool_placement, content_hash for incremental sync.
One row per endpoint: method/path/kind plus the Epic B request_schema/response_schema/auth_scopes payload contract.
bge-small (384-dim) vectors for each sdk/endpoint/scenario/ingest card; HNSW cosine index for the retrieve hot path.

hooks.name: syncCatalog
hooks.description: Scan manifests, content-hash diff, upsert + re-embed only changed SDKs. Idempotent; runs in the api-gateway boot sequence after runMigrations().

hooks.name: searchCatalog
hooks.description: Semantic search over catalog.embedding (optionally restricted to a ref_kind such as 'ingest'); aggregates to the best score per SDK.

hooks.name: getEndpoint
hooks.description: Fetch the full payload contract (method/path/kind/request_schema/response_schema/auth_scopes) for an SDK endpoint.

hooks.name: getIngestTargets
hooks.description: List ingest/bulk endpoints (optionally filtered by an entity term) so ETL agents can discover where to push external data and with what payload.

scenarios.title: Auto-create the catalog store and sync manifests on deploy
scenarios.when_to_use: api-gateway boot. Tables must exist and be populated before the build planner serves its first request — no manual SQL.
scenarios.expected_outcome: catalog.* tables exist; changed SDKs are upserted and re-embedded; unchanged SDKs skipped by content_hash; the catalog version bumps when anything changed.

scenarios.title: Semantic retrieve for the Build-with-AI planner
scenarios.when_to_use: The /api/build/plan pipeline: embed the tenant intent, retrieve the top-K candidate SDKs from the store, then compose a plan from candidates only.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns the most relevant SDKs by cosine similarity over catalog.embedding, replacing the old full-catalog LLM dump.

scenarios.title: An ETL agent discovers where to import data
scenarios.when_to_use: An ETL/custom agent needs to push external records into a ProjexCloud app and must find the ingest endpoint + payload contract.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns ingest/bulk endpoints with their request_schema and auth_scopes so the agent calls the documented API instead of guessing.

compliance_posture.notes: Catalog rows are denormalized COPIES of the sdk-capability.json manifests (source of truth in each package). Deterministic per (manifest, model): content_hash gates re-sync and the pinned embedding model prevents vector-space drift. No tenant data — global, public SDK metadata only.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per semantic search over the catalog (bge-small query embed + HNSW lookup)
